{{Quote|You're just going to stick her in carbonite! She's a Jedi, and the Temple's right here!''"<br />"''Too bad you didn't bring her down a few meters from here then, isn't it? This is not your jurisdiction, ''Jedi''.|Yaqeel Saav'etu and the Quarren officer|<ref name="Omen" />}}
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] '''officer''' served with [[Galactic Alliance Security]] in [[43 ABY]]. When [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jysella Horn]] developed a [[Force psychosis|psychosis]] that caused her to believe that everyone had been replaced by impostors, a team of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] Security [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]], including the Quarren, [[Skirmish on the Processional Way|captured]] her on the [[Processional Way/Legends|Processional Way]], just outside of the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. The [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Knight [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]] tried to [[Mind trick/Legends|persuade]] the Quarren to release Horn to Jedi custody, but he proved resilient to the Jedi's influence. He went on to threaten Saav'etu with arrest for interfering with Horn's capture, reasserting the Galactic Alliance's authority in the situation.

==Biography==
{{Quote|She was taken down by the GA and will go to them for evaluation.|The Quarren, on Jysella Horn|<ref name="Omen" />}}
[[File:Jysellabyshea.jpg|thumb|right|180px|Jedi Knight Jysella Horn, who was apprehended by the unidentified Quarren officer]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Quarren/Legends|Quarren]] lived around the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Second Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="Omen" /> By [[43 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'' to [[43 ABY]].</ref> he had become an [[Officer/Legends|officer]] within [[Galactic Alliance Security]], serving on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="Omen" /> That [[Standard year/Legends|year]],<ref name="Date" /> several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] began to fall under the [[Force psychosis|psychotic]] influence of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] entity [[Abeloth]], causing them to believe that everyone who remained unaffected had been replaced by impostors.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Allies">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Allies]]''</ref> A division between the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]] and the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] resulted, as the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] wanted to have the afflicted Knights available for study, while the Galactic Alliance [[The Galactic Federation of Free Alliances versus Valin Horn|decided]] to [[Carbon-freezing/Legends|encase]] the psychotic Knights in [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]].<ref name="Fate of the Jedi: Outcast">''[[Fate of the Jedi: Outcast]]''</ref>

Around that time, Jedi Knight [[Jysella Horn]] fell prey to the psychosis. She fled from the [[New Jedi Temple|Jedi Temple]] on Coruscant and went on a rampage through the [[Processional Way/Legends|Processional Way]], where two of her friends, the Jedi [[Bazel Warv]] and [[Yaqeel Saav'etu]], [[Skirmish on the Processional Way|attempted]] to stop her. Meanwhile, a contingent of Galactic Alliance Security [[Troop/Legends|troops]], including the Quarren officer, rushed to the scene to try and capture Horn. Horn fled straight toward the approaching Security forces and was shot with a [[Stun/Legends|stun]] bolt, causing her to fall unconscious.<ref name="Omen" />

The Security forces quickly apprehended her, and the Quarren officer was speaking into a [[Comlink/Legends|handheld device]] when he was approached by Saav'etu. The Jedi attempted to use a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]] to get the officer to turn Horn over to Jedi custody, but the Quarren proved impervious to her influence, threatening to arrest her for interfering with Horn's apprehension. He also added that, as they were outside of the Jedi Temple, they were within the Galactic Alliance's jurisdiction&mdash;not within the Jedi's&mdash;forcing Saav'etu to yield.<ref name="Omen" />

==Personality and traits==
{{Quote|Too bad you didn't bring her down a few meters from here then, isn't it? This is not your jurisdiction, Jedi.|The Quarren officer to Yaqeel Saav'etu|<ref name="Omen" />}}
The officer expressed amusement at Saav'etu's frustration following her failed attempt to influence his mind, reasserting to her that, as they were outside of the Jedi Temple, they were not under Jedi jurisdiction. His face tentacles twitched both when he was irritated and amused, and he spoke the word "Jedi" with clear contempt.<ref name="Omen" />

==Skills and abilities==
{{Quote|I'm sure your superiors will agree that the Jedi belongs in the Temple. I'll take charge of the prisoner from here.''"<br />"''Not likely, Jedi. Take your mind tricks elsewhere and step back before I have you arrested for interfering with the prisoner's arrest.|The Quarren officer resists Yaqeel Saav'etu's mind trick|<ref name="Omen" />}}
The Quarren officer was able to resist the mind trick of Jedi Knight Yaqeel Saav'etu, refusing to hand Horn over to her when she attempted to persuade him with [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to do so. He was aggravated by her attempt and threatened to arrest her for interfering with Horn's capture.<ref name="Omen" />

==Equipment==
The Quarren office was equipped with a handheld device for communication purposes.<ref name="Omen" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Quarren officer appeared in the [[2009]] novel ''[[Fate of the Jedi: Omen]]'', the second installment of the nine-part [[Star Wars: Fate of the Jedi|''Fate of the Jedi'']] series written by author [[Christie Golden]].<ref name="Omen" />
